headline: No Close Games This Week, but demon44 Sits Brock Purdy's 28.2 and Loses by 53
meme_brief: A manager benches the guy who scores more than anyone else in his own lineup, then loses by more than fifty points anyway — the fantasy equivalent of forgetting your umbrella on the one day it actually rains inside your house.
recap: There was no genuinely close game in Week 11 — the nearest finish was Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier's 128.70-109.08 win over LaHorrible, a 19.62-point margin that clears this league's threshold for a nail-biter, so nobody gets to call it one. Jared Goff quietly led Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier with 24.36 points in that win, with George Kittle (18.40) doing damage underneath. LaHorrible got 27.46 from C.J. Stroud and 26.22 from Cam Ward but didn't have the depth to match it.
transaction_desk: The week's moves were mostly low-cost tinkering. Playing for 2027 spent a mid-tier priority slot (8th of 12) on Ben Sinnott, who has not yet scored for them. Full Chuba used priority slot 6 of 12 on Xavier Hutchinson, who shares an NFL team and position with Tank Dell on that same roster — a sensible depth/insurance move rather than a speculative flier, though Hutchinson has only produced 2.3 points so far. The Josh Allens picked up Emari Demercado as an uncontested free agent, cutting Carson Wentz; Demercado doubles as insurance behind David Montgomery on that roster and has already chipped in 3.9 points. demon44 added Austin Ekeler off waivers, but with that roster already sitting at the back of the priority order, the cost was essentially nothing, and Ekeler has returned 5.4 points since — low risk, modest reward. Theme From The Bottom kept churning, adding Aidan O'Connell at quarterback (dropping Austin Ekeler, who they'd previously rostered) and then flipping Samaje Perine for Gavin Bartholomew later in the week — both moves uncontested, neither having produced points yet.
trade_desk: Two trades went through this week. Brent Looking 4 His Keys sent out a 2028 third (originally mikelanta's) and a 2028 second (originally demon44's) to acquire Jordan Addison, age 24, plus a 2028 fourth, from Playing for 2027. Our read: Brent Looking 4 His Keys, currently outside the playoff picture, gave up two future assets including an early-round pick for a 24-year-old receiver — a bet on a player over draft capital that makes more sense for a team trying to climb now than one still building, so the fit for a team sitting outside the top six is worth watching. The second trade was pure draft-capital shuffling: demon44 sent out a 2027 second and a 2028 first to land a 2028 fifth, a 2027 first (originally Full Chuba's) and a 2028 second (originally Theme From The Bottom's) from mikelanta. Our read: demon44 turned one premium pick into three, including another team's first-rounder, which reads as a quantity-over-quality approach — reasonable if the plan is to keep stacking selections for a rebuild, though giving up a true first for a bundle that includes a fifth-round throw-in is a lot of moving parts for a team that already sits at 4-7.

standings_narrative: The race for the sixth and final playoff seed is not close right now. The Josh Allens hold it with 1305.38 season points, leading Playing for 2027 by 34.86, Kirkumcised Penix by 58.62, and Brent Looking 4 His Keys by 89.3 — a gap that clears the tight-race threshold, so there's breathing room there for now, even after The Josh Allens' 48-point loss this week. The top five seeds by record are set as things stand: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier at 9-2 holds the first seed, followed by NateDawg726 (8-3), Silverbacks (100 vs 1) at 7-4, and a tie in the loss column between Full Chuba and LaHorrible at 6-5 apiece rounding out seeds four and five. Playing for 2027 sits at 6-5 as well but currently projects as the team on the bubble for the points-based sixth seed, trailing The Josh Allens by that same 34.86-point margin despite a .500 record.
look_ahead: Ja'Marr Ja'Merrier, the league's top seed at 9-2, visits Playing for 2027, who sit at 6-5 and are fighting for ground in the sixth-seed points race. Brent Looking 4 His Keys and Silverbacks (100 vs 1) meet with records of 5-6 and 7-4 respectively. Theme From The Bottom, at 1-10, faces Full Chuba, who sit at 6-5 and hold the fourth seed. The Josh Allens, currently the sixth seed by points at 5-6, take on LaHorrible at 6-5. Kirkumcised Penix and mikelanta square off at 5-6 and 4-7. NateDawg726, at 8-3, plays demon44, who sit at 4-7.

running_jokes: Theme From The Bottom added yet another pair of free agents this week (an uncontested quarterback and tight end swap) while sitting at 1-10, continuing the volume approach without results so far.
